use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: Allow the customer to monitor the status of current and past auctions.

goal.raw_text: Allow the customer to monitor the status of current and past auctions.

claims.content: Customer
The customer navigates to the auction status page to view current and past auctions.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to the auction status page to view current and past auctions.

claims.content: The customer navigates to the Customer History page to view their auction activity.
The customer may search for specific records by entering criteria such as Customer Email Address, Home Phone, or Name and clicking 'Go'.
The system displays a list of matching customer accounts if multiple are found, or proceeds to show history details.
The customer views the 'Order History' section, which lists past orders with details including Order Date, Auction Sequence, Item Number, Order Amount, and Status (e.g., Complete, Order Cancelled).
The customer views the 'Bid History' section, which lists bid activity including Closed Date/Time, Auction Sequence, Item Number, Last Bid, Max Bid, and Winning Bid status.

If the search by customer e-mail address, phone number, or name returns multiple matching accounts, the system displays a 'Results' section listing all matches with details such as Last Name, First Name, City, State, Zip, Phone, and E-mail address, requiring the user to select a specific record to view history.
The system displays an 'Order History' section listing past orders with details including Order Date, Auction Sequence, Item Number, Order Amount, and Status (e.g., Complete, Order Cancelled).
The system displays a 'Bid History' section listing bid activity including Closed Date/Time, Auction Sequence, Item Number, Last Bid, Max Bid, and Winning Bid status.
The bid history page includes sections for 'Items I've Won' and 'Items I Bid On, But Did Not Win', sorted by ending time with the most recent on top.
For won items, the system displays a 'Payment Status' column indicating 'Paid' or 'Not Paid' (in bold red if unpaid and linked to payment page).
